item.title: Unusually warm air is coming this week
item.description: Temperatures could reach 80 degrees by Thursday afternoon

item.title: For February, very warm weather this week; Rain returns by Friday
item.description: Temperatures warm to near 70° Monday. Monday night looks mainly clear with lows in the mid 40s. Some fog may develop, especially across southwest Alabama, early Tuesday morning.

item.title: Sixth Annual Kite Festival Brings Multicultural Celebration to Montgomery
item.description: Community members are encouraged to bring their own kites to the sixth annual Kite Festival on Saturday, Feb. 21.

item.title: Parade, Pledge Signing to Mark Higher Education Day in Montgomery
item.description: The Higher Education Day parade will feature mascots, marching bands, flags and students representing Alabama’s 14 public, four-year universities.

item.title: Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall dies at 95
item.description: "The Godfather," released in 1972, established Robert Duvall as one of the most in-demand performers of Hollywood, who had many classic roles over the decades.

item.title: A False Spring Ahead
item.description: Temps soar into the upper 70s to lower 80s late week but colder air will be returning next week.

item.title: ACTION 8 UPDATE: Judge dismisses lawsuit Autauga County sheriff filed against county commission
item.description: A lawsuit that Autauga County Sheriff Mark Harrell had filed against the Autauga County Commission over conditions at the jail and other issues has been dismissed.

item.title: A vigil for a man on death row was held at the governor’s mansion Monday night
item.description: Dozens of people show up for a vigil at the governor's mansion to support a man on death row.

item.title: Alabama State blows out Mississippi Valley on the hardwood
item.description: Alabama State earns their 9th win of the season against Mississippi Valley.
